headlineMentions.title: Photo Finish
headlineMentions.narrative: James Allen edged Reshad de Gerus at the line by 0.189 seconds.

headlineMentions.title: Hard Charger
headlineMentions.narrative: Reshad de Gerus climbed from P23 to P6, the biggest gain in class.

headlineMentions.title: Closing In
headlineMentions.narrative: Dane Cameron cut James Allen's championship lead from 13 points to 1.

headlineMentions.title: Statement Lap
headlineMentions.narrative: Matt Stenzel's fastest lap beat the field by 3.258 seconds, the biggest margin of the race.

headlineMentions.title: Hard Charger
headlineMentions.narrative: Matt Stenzel climbed from P10 to P1, the biggest gain in class.

headlineMentions.title: Photo Finish
headlineMentions.narrative: Paul Lanchère edged Daniel Nogales at the line by 0.133 seconds.
